plan.metric: candidate outright wins / all scheduled games; draws and unfinished games count as non-wins
plan.acceptanceClock: production monotonic clock and unscaled profiles; predecessor remains 8000ms/200000 nodes/depth12
plan.policy: Freeze the candidate before holdout. Preserve all failed holdout attempts; do not tune against held-out records or drop losses. A scaled selection result alone does not satisfy this acceptance gate.
